annotations.title: Reply to anything in the inbox

description: Answer an inbox item BY ITS COMPOSITE ID — the `id` list_inbox returned, e.g. 'facebook:123_456' or 'google_business:accounts/1/locations/2/reviews/3'. Routes to the right channel for you; you do not need to know which reply tool a platform uses. The reply is posted as the brand — PUBLIC on every comment, reply, mention and review, and PRIVATE on the DM sources, WhatsApp and Intercom (it goes to the customer from the brand's support inbox) — so show the user the exact wording and get their go-ahead first either way. X is the one exception and says so: a reply there is a new post, so it goes through post_to_x with replyTo. A WhatsApp reply goes out only while the 24-hour window is open (windowOpen on the item); after that WhatsApp accepts only an approved template, so the reply is refused for free and send_whatsapp_message with `template` is the way.

id.description: The composite id from list_inbox — '<source>:<platform id>'. A bare platform id is refused: replying to the wrong network as the brand cannot be taken back.

text.description: The reply, exactly as it should appear publicly.
